page_title: Item:The Shrouded Steps of the Beyond

enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +14: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.

Enhanced Ghostly: Equipping this item causes you to become partially incorporeal. Your melee attacks do not roll a miss chance for Incorporeal targets. Enemy attacks have a 15% chance to miss you due to incorporeality. You receive a +5 enhancement bonus to your Hide and Move Silently skills.
Insightful Dodge +6%: +6% Insight bonus to Dodge.
Quality Dodge +3%: +3% Quality bonus to Dodge.

enchantments.text: This Minor Artifact has a maximum of 3 filigree slots.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
